Paste a song with inline chords (`[G] Abigail`) or with chords on their own
line above the lyrics. The transposer guesses the key from the first chord;
pick the key you want to play in. Every song page also has a key menu at the
top that does the same thing.

```{=html}
<div class="tool">
  <label for="transpose-input" class="form-label">Song</label>
  <textarea id="transpose-input" class="form-control font-monospace" rows="14" spellcheck="false">[G] Abigail, can you feel my [C] heart in the [G] palm of your [D] hand
and do you [Em] understand [C] why I can't sta-[G]-aa-[D]-aay</textarea>
  <div class="tool-actions">
    <label for="transpose-from">From</label>
    <select id="transpose-from" class="form-select form-select-sm"></select>
    <label for="transpose-to">to</label>
    <button id="transpose-down" type="button" class="btn btn-sm btn-outline-secondary" aria-label="Down a semitone">−</button>
    <select id="transpose-to" class="form-select form-select-sm"></select>
    <button id="transpose-up" type="button" class="btn btn-sm btn-outline-secondary" aria-label="Up a semitone">+</button>
    <span id="transpose-shift" class="text-secondary"></span>
  </div>
  <label for="transpose-output" class="form-label">Transposed</label>
  <textarea id="transpose-output" class="form-control font-monospace" rows="14" spellcheck="false"></textarea>
  <div class="tool-actions">
    <button id="transpose-copy" type="button" class="btn btn-outline-secondary btn-sm">Copy</button>
  </div>
</div>
```

The melody numbers in a song are scale degrees, so they stay the same in every
key; only the chords change.
